{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"000000000000063A1Y8FFCN2SF","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram flow=right
group events "Activation events" {
  node Startup "Startup" ref="packages/sdk/app-framework/src/common/activation-events.ts"
  node Article "Article requested" below Startup ref="packages/sdk/app-framework/src/common/activation-events.ts"
  node Idle "Idle" below Article ref="packages/sdk/app-framework/src/common/activation-events.ts"
}
group modules "Stash modules" right-of events {
  node Translations "translations" same-row Startup ref="docs/src/app-framework-tutorial/src/translations.ts"
  node Schema "schema" below Translations ref="docs/src/app-framework-tutorial/src/capabilities/schema.ts"
  node Ops "operation-handler" below Schema ref="docs/src/app-framework-tutorial/src/capabilities/operation-handler.ts"
  node Surface "react-surface" below Ops ref="docs/src/app-framework-tutorial/src/capabilities/react-surface.ts"
  node Graph "app-graph-builder" below Surface ref="docs/src/app-framework-tutorial/src/capabilities/app-graph-builder.ts"
}
group caps "Capabilities" right-of modules {
  node CTranslations "Translations" same-row Translations ref="packages/sdk/app-toolkit/src/app-framework/AppCapabilities.ts"
  node CSchema "Schema" same-row Schema ref="packages/sdk/app-toolkit/src/app-framework/AppCapabilities.ts"
  node COps "OperationHandler" same-row Ops ref="packages/sdk/app-framework/src/common/capabilities.ts"
  node CSurface "ReactSurface" same-row Surface ref="packages/sdk/app-framework/src/common/capabilities.ts"
  node CGraph "AppGraphBuilder" same-row Graph ref="packages/sdk/app-toolkit/src/app-framework/AppCapabilities.ts"
}
edge Startup -> Translations
edge Startup -> Schema
edge Startup -> Ops
edge Article -> Surface
edge Idle -> Graph
edge Translations -> CTranslations
edge Schema -> CSchema
edge Ops -> COps
edge Surface -> CSurface
edge Graph -> CGraph
